data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Awwaza', meaning 'he who is intelligent, brave and powerful'. The name Awwaz carries the meaning “Intelligent, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Awwaz usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awwaz total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
